gbm_population_evidence.quote: Recurrence of GBM (WHO grade IV) based on RANO criteria or GBM after subtotal resection of recurrence with macroscopic residual tumor;

candidate_evidence.quote: SRS procedure will be delivered within 7 days after start of TTFields therapy .

source_quote.quote: Overall survival will be stratified by volume, PET-based treatment, SVZ invasion, MGMT methylation status, time to first progression, and TTFields compliance.

The attempt to obtain the Methyl-guanine methyl-transferase (MGMT) gene promoter methylation and IDH1 and IDH2 mutation from primary tumor are made during the study whenever not defined before entering to the study.

coder_notes: Interventions are TTFields (device) plus stereotactic radiosurgery; no drug is a registered intervention. 18F-FET PET tracer appears only in the title, keywords and arm text as imaging, not as a registered intervention, so it is not listed (R9). MGMT stratification is an analysis stratification in a single-arm trial, coded exploratory_correlative.
